findings.title: enableSqlExpressions logic bug - always returns false regardless of feature flag state
findings.body: The function negates the feature flag check (`!h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(...)`) and then both branches return false. This means SQL expressions are now unconditionally disabled no matter what the feature flag value is, which happens to achieve the goal here (disabling the vulnerable feature), but the logic is dead/confusing code with an unreachable branch and inverted naming (checking `!IsEnabledGlobally` but naming the var `enabled`). This is misleading for future maintainers who may try to re-enable the feature by flipping the flag, not realizing the function can never return true.

findings.title: TablesList still composes raw SQL into a command string even though the DB backend is a stub
findings.body: TablesList still builds a SQL command string via fmt.Sprintf with user-controlled rawSQL (only escaping single quotes) and passes it to RunCommands. Although the new DB.RunCommands always returns 'not implemented', this leaves a latent SQL/command-injection-prone pattern in the code; if RunCommands is ever reimplemented without careful review, the vulnerability could be reintroduced. The PR description says this is a stopgap, but the unsafe raw string construction remains a landmine for future implementers.

findings.title: Stub DB methods always return errors, causing SQL expression users to see generic/opaque failures
findings.body: NewInMemoryDB/TablesList/RunCommands/QueryFramesInto are now stub methods that always return 'not implemented' errors. Combined with reader.go's enableSqlExpressions always returning false, the SQL expression type is effectively dead code behind an always-false gate, yet this new stub also runs independently in sql_command.go and parser.go error paths. There's no test coverage verifying these stub behaviors or verifying that SQL expressions are indeed fully disabled end-to-end (e.g., a test that attempts to create an SQL command and asserts the expected 'not implemented' error).

findings.title: Removed go-duck dependency but no corresponding version bump or changelog note
findings.body: The PR removes github.com/scottlepp/go-duck/duck entirely and the DuckDB-based implementation, replacing it with stub functions, but there's no documentation update explaining to users that SQL Expressions are now completely non-functional (not just feature-flagged) and why. The PR description explicitly says documentation isn't touched, but given this disables a previously working (if vulnerable) feature, users with the feature flag enabled will now get hard failures without any release note added in this diff.
